main.description: A mutable named pointer to a version. Resolve the manifest through the referenced version. The record key is '{projectName}:{channelName}', making uniqueness per (project, name) mechanical and enabling AppView-free resolution. Channel names follow the project-name grammar (lowercase alphanumerics, interior hyphens, no dots). The project name cannot contain colons, but the rkey must contain exactly one colon. Valid only when same-DID with the referenced project and version.

project.description: The software.release.project this pointer belongs to. MUST be same-DID.

name.description: Channel name (e.g. latest, next). Follows the project-name grammar. MUST match the record rkey after the colon.

version.description: Strong reference to the software.release.version this channel currently points to. MUST belong to the same project.
